changelog.consulta: Check the latest changes, improvements, and fixes made in ContiA.

highlights.text: Support for Google's Veo 2 model for ultra-realistic video generation.
Integration with AWS's Nova Canva for brand-based graphic generation.
Performance improvements on initial load and user dashboard.
Fixed an issue that prevented video generation on some mobile browsers.
New Nova Reel model integrated for TikTok-style content up to 6 seconds.
Added support for Google Image 4.0 as the image generation engine.
New generation interface design for easier mobile navigation.
Minor validation adjustments on the support form.
